pieces.Text: Your shape changes to that of a dire wolverine (Bestiary p279). While in this form, you gain a climb speed of 10 feet, two claw attacks (1d8 damage), a bite attack (1d6 damage), low-light vision, and scent (30 feet). While in dire wolverine form, you gain the barbarian's rage power, but can activate this rage only in a round after you've taken damage. You can rage for
rounds each day. This ability otherwise functions the same as the barbarian rage ability (unlike a dire wolverine, you can choose to end this rage voluntarily).
You can choose two barbarian rage powers, treating your shifter level as your effective barbarian level for the purposes of meeting prerequisites.
You are no longer fatigued at the end of your rage.
